releases.title: 加速史多了一条可以走的路：从火堆到巨石
body: 加速史新增一个连续的三维世界，取代原来一间一间的工坊。从一百万年前夜里的火堆出发，走过第一把种子、清晨的村落和下午的麦田，走到麦田中央那块石头为止；天色和年份跟着脚步变。路上可以给火添柴、播下种子、触碰巨石。键盘、鼠标和手机都能走，也可以开自动前行。沿途有围火的人、清晨的村落、水渠和收割的人，后世的风车和电塔随脚步从麦田里升起；声音是现场合成的，可以关掉。入口在加速史时间轴下方的「走完整条路」和“更多”的创作一栏，地址是 /chronicle/walk。
十五座时代工坊和工坊目录同时下线，原来的地址都转到这条路；浏览器里存的工坊完成记录不再读取。

en.title: The Chronicle gains a road you can walk: From Fire to Monolith
body: The Chronicle now has one continuous 3D world in place of its separate workshops. Start at a hearth a million years ago and walk past the first handful of seed, a village at dawn and the afternoon wheat, as far as the stone standing in the middle of the field; the hour and the year change with your steps. Along the way you can feed the fire, sow the seed and touch the monolith. It works with keyboard, mouse and phone, and there is an auto-walk. People sit around the fire, a village wakes at dawn, a canal runs beside reapers, and later windmills and pylons rise out of the wheat as you walk; the sound is synthesized live and can be switched off. Enter from Walk the whole road under the Chronicle's timeline, from Make under More, or at /chronicle/walk.
The fifteen era workshops and their directory are retired, and their addresses now lead to the walk; workshop progress saved in your browser is no longer read.

releases.title: 推荐理由写这件事改变了什么
body: 精选条目的推荐理由不再复述原文讲了什么，改为说明这件事改变了什么、对谁有影响：门槛和价格的变化、与前代或竞品的比较、哪些工作交给了模型，或者研究结果验证到了哪一步。新入选的条目开始使用新写法，已有条目保持不变。

en.title: Why it matters says what changed
body: The Why it matters line on picked stories no longer retells what the source covers. It now says what changed and for whom: a lower price or barrier, a comparison with the previous version or a rival, work handed to a model, or how far a research result has been verified. Newly picked stories use it; earlier ones stay as they are.

releases.title: 外观开关只在能换色的页面出现
body: 首页、日报、编年史等夜间页面无论选哪种外观都保持深色，页脚不再显示在这些页面上不起作用的深浅色开关；在条目、报告和话题页面仍可切换。“更多”里的外观选项随之移除。
英文版“关于”页的信源统计不再夹杂中文：网页、公众号等类型显示为英文。

en.title: The theme switch shows only where it works
body: Night pages such as the front page, the daily and the chronicle stay dark in either theme, so their footer no longer shows a light/dark switch that changed nothing there; items, reports and topics still offer it. The appearance row in More goes with it.
The English About page lists its source kinds in English, with no Chinese labels left in the counts.

releases.title: 头条更可靠，页面宽度统一
body: 日报头条只选新闻：只要当期有新闻，教程和观点就不当头条；同样重要的几件事，先排一手发布，再看报道的信源多少和谁先发，不再由随机顺序决定。
新增一手官方信源：Anthropic 新闻、Claude 博客、Google AI 博客、Apple 机器学习研究、DeepSeek、Kimi、MiniMax、Cohere，官方原文会先于媒体转述收录。
AI 公司和它们的 CEO、创始人在 X 上的账号现在算作官方发布方，排序时优先用当事方自己的帖子；公司账号发的新闻点赞远超平时水平时，会在日报里排得更靠前。
移除 The Decoder，它的文章已从全站下架；雷锋网和几位发帖多、入选少的 X 作者改为只计入热度，不再进精选。
所有页面统一成和首页一样的居中版面，宽屏上不再铺满整个窗口。

en.title: More reliable leads, one page width
body: The daily's lead is always news: a how-to or an opinion leads only when the issue has no news, and equally important stories rank first-hand first, then by how many sources carried them and who reported first, never by chance.

New first-party sources: Anthropic News, the Claude blog, Google's AI blog, Apple Machine Learning Research, DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax and Cohere, so official posts arrive before the coverage that repeats them.

X accounts of AI companies and their CEOs and founders now count as official publishers, so a story is told from the company's own post first; a company's news post liked far above its usual ranks higher in the daily.
The Decoder is removed and its articles are withdrawn; Leiphone and a few prolific X authors whose posts were rarely selected now count only toward heat.
Every page now uses the home page's centred column instead of stretching across wide screens.

releases.title: 订阅邮件换上夜色
body: 日报、确认信和壁纸信都换成和网站一样的夜色麦田：头条放在最前面，后面是编号栏目。
日报补上了快讯，头条不再在栏目里重复一遍。
每封日报最后多了今日读数：K 值、智能成本和时间轴上的“现在”。

en.title: The newsletter goes dark
body: The daily issue, confirmation and wallpaper letters now share the site's night wheat field: the lead story comes first, followed by numbered sections.
The daily issue now includes briefs, and the lead story is no longer repeated in its section.
Each daily issue ends with today's reading: the K value, the cost of intelligence and "now" on the timeline.

releases.title: 首页重做：降临是一条曲线
body: 第一屏换成新的主张和主图：夜色麦田里的一块黑色石碑。标语是「降临不是一个日期，而是一条曲线」。
手机打开就能看到今日头条、时间轴和一句智能成本读数，宣言入口也回到手机上。
首页去掉首访订阅引导、首屏订阅按钮和热点条；分类和搜索收进全部动态，订阅仍在顶部和订阅页。

en.title: A new front page: the arrival is a curve
body: The first screen has a new line and a new image: a black slab in a field of wheat at night. The line reads “The arrival is not a date. It is a curve.”
Phones now open on today's lead, the timeline and one reading of the cost of intelligence, and the manifesto link is back on phones.

The first-visit subscribe screen, the subscribe button in the first screen and the hot strip have left the front page. Categories and search now live on All, and Subscribe stays in the top bar and on its own page.

releases.title: 降临派宣言
body: 新增「降临派宣言」：本站自己的主张——人与 AI 像人和小麦一样共生演化，我们迎接硅基生命的降临；也写明我们和 e/acc（拯救派）、和《三体》降临派的分歧，以及我们不做的事。中英文两版。
入口在「更多」菜单的「了解 e/acc」、首页首屏和关于页。

en.title: The Adventist Manifesto
body: New: the Adventist Manifesto, this site's own view — humans and AI co-evolve the way humans and wheat did, and we welcome the arrival of silicon life. It also says where we part from e/acc (the Redemptionists) and from The Three-Body Problem, and what we will not do. In English and Chinese.
Find it under Understand e/acc in the More menu, on the front page and on the about page.

releases.title: 两篇 e/acc 概念页：宣言与代币
body: 新增「e/acc 宣言」：被称作宣言的三篇文本——2022 年奠基通讯、《原则与信条笔记》和 Andreessen 的《技术乐观主义宣言》——各讲了什么，以及有哪些回应和批评，附原文链接。
新增「e/acc 代币」：e/acc 没有官方代币，本站也没有；说明梗币为什么借用这个名字，以及相信之前要核对什么。
智能成本指数的网页标题改为「AI 模型 token 价格变化」，更贴近人们搜索时的说法。

en.title: Two e/acc explainers: the manifesto and the token
body: New: the e/acc manifesto — what the three texts that get the name say (the 2022 founding post, the principles and tenets, and Andreessen's Techno-Optimist Manifesto), and how people responded, with links to the originals.
New: the e/acc token — there is no official e/acc token, and this site has none; why meme tokens borrow the name and what to check before trusting one.
The cost-of-intelligence index's page title now reads "AI Price per Token Over Time", closer to how people search for it.

releases.title: 首页第一屏看见加速史
body: 首页第一屏的右侧换成加速史的「此刻」：最近一个有配图的里程碑，点开就进加速史。
第一屏底部是从大爆炸到预测的整条对数时间轴，指针停在今天，下面四个读数：卡尔达肖夫指数、人类一次能源功率、每美元算力和世界人口。今日头条移到第一屏下方「今天，在曲线上」，热点和精选照旧。
热点事件页也换成首页的夜色，标题下的时间改为「X 前更新」。

en.title: The front page opens on the Acceleration timeline
body: The right side of the front page's first screen now shows Acceleration's "Right now": the latest illustrated milestone, which opens the timeline.

Along the foot of the first screen runs the whole log timeline from the Big Bang to the forecasts, with a needle at today and four readings below it: the Kardashev index, human primary power, compute per dollar and world population. Today's lead story moves just below, under "Today, on the curve"; trending and picks are unchanged.
Trending event pages now share the front page's night look, and the line under the title reads "Updated … ago".

releases.title: 「前沿」页直接读数
body: 页头下方一排读数：第一名的共识指数和价格、智能成本降了多少倍、当前的卡尔达肖夫指数。
下面的卡片直接画出内容：模型榜前五名带厂商标志和分数条，前五名的输入输出价格画在对数刻度上，智能成本画出各档能力的价格阶梯，卡尔达肖夫指数用刻度尺显示。

en.title: Frontier now shows its readings
body: A row of readings sits under the page header: the leading model's consensus index and price, how many times cheaper the same intelligence has become, and today's Kardashev rating.

The cards below draw their content: the top five models with their makers' logos and score bars, those models' input and output prices on a log scale, the cost of intelligence as price steps for each capability tier, and the Kardashev rating on its scale.

releases.title: 新闻配上原文的预览图
body: 网页报道在卡片和文章页上显示原文自己的分享预览图，文章页注明图片来源，点击打开原文。各网站通用的默认图和太小的图不显示。
X 帖子的配图和原文现在都直接显示在卡片和文章页上。

en.title: News now comes with the original's preview image
body: Web reports show the original page's own share image on their cards and article pages, credited to the source and linked to the original. Site-wide default images and small images are left out.
X posts now show their own text and images on cards and article pages.

releases.title: 导航重新分层，新增「前沿」
body: 顶部导航收成精选、日报、加速史和前沿四项。前沿是新的总览页，把模型榜、模型价格和智能成本指数放在一起，并显示当前的卡尔达肖夫指数。
「更多」按阅读、了解 e/acc、创作、我的、本站分组，每一项都有一句说明。热点、全部动态和产品目录都移到了这里。顶栏新增搜索和订阅按钮，语言改成 EN / 中文 切换。手机底栏与电脑一致。

en.title: A clearer menu, and a new Frontier page
body: The top bar is now Picks, Daily, Acceleration and Frontier. Frontier is a new overview that brings together the model leaderboard, model prices and the cost-of-intelligence index, along with today's Kardashev rating.

More is grouped into Read, Understand e/acc, Make, Yours and This site, with a line on what each page holds. Trending, All news and Products now live there. The top bar gains search and Subscribe buttons, and the language is a two-button English / Chinese toggle. The phone tab bar matches the desktop.

releases.title: 十座时代工坊迎来白天
body: 文字、铁器、印刷、蒸汽、电光、飞行、逻辑、轨道和网络九座工坊开了真正的窗洞，阳光斜照进来，在地板和装置上留下窗格光影；墙面与地板提亮，窗外能看到天空和远山。观星工坊保留夜景，改由月光与灯光照明。

en.title: Daylight in the ten era workshops
body: Nine workshops — writing, iron, printing, steam, electricity, flight, logic, docking and networks — now have real window openings, so sunlight falls across the floor and apparatus in window-shaped patches, with lighter walls and a view of sky and hills. The observatory stays a night scene, lit by moonlight and lamps.

releases.title: 加速史画面全面高清升级
body: 加速史的 154 套时代与事件画作新增适配不同屏幕的高清版本，最高宽 3840 像素；工坊窗景与工程插画也同步增强。画面保留原有构图，使用本地超分处理。

en.title: Sharper artwork across Chronicle
body: All 154 era and event artworks now have enhanced versions for different screens, up to 3,840 pixels wide. Workshop panoramas and the engineering illustration have also been enhanced, preserving their original framing.

releases.title: 工坊记住你的探索进度
body: 十五座时代工坊加入完成状态与挑战记录，工坊目录和加速史入口会显示进度；记录保存在当前浏览器中。

en.title: Workshop progress and completion
body: The fifteen era workshops now show completion and challenge records in the directory and Chronicle. Progress is stored in your browser.

releases.title: 补全历史节点，校正时代画面
body: 加速史新增雕版《金刚经》、雅卡尔提花机、曼彻斯特 Baby 的电子存储程序和 MOS 场效应晶体管四个节点；洛夫莱斯程序和图灵机也有了独立插画。
重新绘制部分与年代或器物不符的图片，让历史场景与所讲述的事件更贴近。

en.title: New milestones and more faithful historical art
body: Chronicle adds four milestones: the printed Diamond Sutra, the Jacquard loom, Manchester Baby’s electronic stored program and the MOSFET. Lovelace’s program and the Turing machine also receive dedicated illustrations.
Several illustrations were redrawn to better reflect the era and objects they depict.

releases.title: 精选首页焕新
body: 精选首页加入当天头条和文明读数，将重要内容、热点与通往加速史的入口放在更清晰的阅读路径中。

en.title: A new front page
body: The picks page brings the day’s lead story and civilization readings together, with clearer paths to the news, trending stories and Chronicle.

releases.title: 十五座时代工坊
body: 从石器、火与农业，到印刷、飞行、电路与网络，走进十五座可交互的三维工坊。时间轴标记和工坊目录可以帮助找到可进入的历史时刻。

en.title: Fifteen interactive era workshops
body: Explore fifteen interactive 3D workshops, from stone tools, fire and agriculture to printing, flight, circuits and networks. Timeline markers and the workshop directory lead to the scenes.

releases.title: 走进加速史的画面
body: 加速史加入纵深画廊与可进入的 1822 差分机工坊，从观察插画过渡到探索三维场景。

en.title: Step inside Chronicle
body: A depth tunnel and an explorable 1822 Difference Engine workshop connect Chronicle’s illustrations with interactive 3D scenes.

releases.title: 时代画卷与手机壁纸
body: 加速史可以按时代浏览已有画作；壁纸新增专为手机纵屏构图的版本，桌面与手机可以选择更合适的画面。

en.title: Era galleries and phone wallpapers
body: Browse Chronicle artwork by era, and choose phone wallpapers composed for portrait screens alongside desktop editions.

releases.title: 比较模型 API 价格
body: 模型榜新增 API 价格与模型之间的价格对比；智能成本指数提供图表和引用方式，帮助读者观察能力与价格的变化。

en.title: Compare model API prices
body: The model leaderboard adds API prices and pairwise comparisons. The cost-of-intelligence index provides a chart and citation information for exploring changes in capability and price.

releases.title: 每日 4K 壁纸
body: 每日壁纸产品上线，提供桌面与手机版预览。已确认的邮件订阅者可以领取积分，下载对应日期的高清壁纸。

en.title: Daily 4K wallpapers
body: Daily wallpapers launch with desktop and phone previews. Confirmed email subscribers can claim credits to download wallpapers for a chosen date.

releases.title: 按页面语言订阅日报
body: 订阅入口加入更多阅读页面；确认后的日报按读者选择的中英文版本发送。

en.title: Subscribe to the daily briefing in your language
body: More reading pages offer the newsletter, and confirmed subscribers receive the daily briefing in their chosen language.

releases.title: 收藏变成阅读清单
body: 收藏的内容可以集中阅读，查看未读标记和事件后续，并支持备份。

en.title: A reading list for saved stories
body: Saved stories now live in a reading list with unread marks, event updates and backup support.

releases.title: 智能成本指数
body: 智能成本指数加入网站，用可追溯的数据观察模型能力与价格的变化，并提供数据来源。

en.title: The cost-of-intelligence index
body: The cost-of-intelligence index joins the site, with traceable sources for exploring changes in model capability and price.

releases.title: 中英文资讯与产品目录
body: 资讯、日报和产品目录支持中英文阅读；英文成为默认版本，中文内容可以通过 /zh 访问。
加速史以独立入口串联历史时间线、文明读数与站点过去的内容。

en.title: News and products in English and Chinese
body: News, daily briefings and the product directory are available in English and Chinese. English is the default, and Chinese pages are available under /zh.
Chronicle provides a dedicated home for the historical timeline, civilization readings and the site’s past coverage.
